---
id: "smk-06"
title: "Manchester United"
---

Manchester United is a professional football club from Old Trafford, Greater Manchester, England. It was founded in 1878 as Newton Heath LYR, a works team of the Lancashire and Yorkshire Railway, and adopted its present name in 1902. The club plays its home games at the Old Trafford stadium, which seats about 74,000 spectators. Manchester United has won the English league title a record number of times, together with numerous FA Cups, League Cups and three European Cups. The club's most successful period came under the manager Alex Ferguson, who was in charge from 1986 to 2013. In 1958 eight players died in the Munich air disaster, a tragedy that remains central to the club's history. Manchester United is one of the most widely supported clubs in the world and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
